title: A customer with a blank term counts as COD and gets no warning
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have customer A, from before the release, with a blank credit term, a credit limit of $500.00 and unpaid invoices totalling $600.00.
  • Start on the Work Orders page.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Work Order".
  2. Pick customer A as the customer.
  3. Confirm the New Work Order window with its create button.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Work Order window opens.

Step 2:

  • The window shows customer A as the customer.

Step 3:

  • No over-credit confirmation opens.
  • The New Work Order goes straight on as for any customer.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11678 (Story 9, Over Credit warning)

  • S9-N2: “The warning and the badge never show for a customer on COD, Due on Receipt or Credit Hold, whatever their limit or balance. A customer with a blank term counts as COD.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
